# WEBSITE.NS17.LAT

- [Personal Website](https://website.ns17.lat/)

> Personal portfolio website of Vedansh (@offensive-vk). Built with Astro, React, and Tailwind CSS. Deployed on Cloudflare Pages.

## Sections

- Home: Hero section with animated title, social links, scrolling tech logo wall, and interactive skills accordion.
- Projects: Showcase of featured projects with GitHub source and live preview links.
- Certifications: Cisco certifications with Credly verification badges.
- Contact: Contact form for professional inquiries.
- Footer: Social links, tech stack attribution, and copyright.

## Tech Stack

- Framework: Astro v6 (Static Site Generator)
- UI Islands: React 19 (Hydrated client-side components)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v3
- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages
- Domain: website.ns17.lat
